annotations.title: Read publish state for content pieces

description: Return publish state for content pieces. Filters by content_id, channel, or both; returns all entries when neither is given. Side effects: read-only; no external HTTP calls; no auth needed. Deterministic given unchanged backend state. Use post_status to inspect what has been published, what is queued, or what errored; use post_publish, post_schedule, or post_drain to change state.

channel.description: Filter to a specific channel slug, e.g. 'devto', 'reddit:ClaudeAI'; omit to return state for all channels.

content_id.description: Filter to a specific content piece by its stable ID; omit to return state for all content.

name: post_status

channel.description: Channel slug the entry belongs to, e.g. 'devto:main'.

content_id.description: Stable content identifier passed to post_publish / post_schedule; matches the content.id field.

error.description: Last error message from the platform; null when no error.

live_url.description: Public URL of the live post; null when not yet published.

next_retry_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 of the next scheduled retry; null when not queued for retry.

published_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the successful publish; null when not yet live.

retry_count.description: Number of publish attempts made so far; null for first attempt.

state.description: Current publish state: live=published, queued=scheduled for future drain, needs_browser=manual step required, failed=last attempt errored.

title: Read publish state for content pieces
